classification: Independent descriptive POST HOC review of fixed observed native traces; outside the canonical independent audit and promotion gate

canonical_native_audit.interpretation: The canonical audit verifies faithful execution, source, metrics and the negative gate result; audit success is not candidate qualification.

method.scope: Read-only original252 saved requests and source inventory; descriptive stage review uses first real repetition only. No new selector, candidate outcome or operational timing experiment was computed.
method.independence: Stage and positive-case checks were separately calculated from saved trace operands with literal physical-line slicing, qualified-symbol equality and evidence SHA256. The existing independent native scorer was also used for saved-window candidate-pool membership checks. No production selector, model, backend, index or replay producer was executed.
method.evidence_semantics: Each required group is OR over its unchanged authored alternatives. One actual allowed qualified-symbol excerpt must contain the full inclusive physical interval with exactly the authored source bytes/hash. Groups are AND requirements; different excerpts are never unioned for credit.
method.stages: Independently checked all14 recorded coverage objects per missing group: raw50/raw8, canonical all/canonical8, canonical dependency eligible, actual arm eligible/character prefixes/prepost/proposal, actual chosen branch eligible/character prefixes/prepost/postprocess, and final delivered. Twelve source stages total1032 checks; independent greedy12000-character prefix reconstruction adds172 checks.
method.partial_precedence: An actually delivered clipped prefix takes precedence over its earlier eligible omission. This correctly attributes hybrid hydration Query.fetch to character-limited backfill rather than treating the final response as a pure slot omission.

candidate_missing_group_taxonomy.unit: First-repetition query/group/retrieval-mode occurrence; two retrieval modes are not independent queries.

one_hop_proposal_pool_check.population: The19 candidate group occurrences that have a full canonical representative but not a covering actual proposed eligible window:18 final allocation misses plus1 subsequently character-clipped backfill occurrence.
one_hop_proposal_pool_check.operand: Actual saved base_receipt.available_candidate_ids, resolved to complete unchanged source-inventory windows.
one_hop_proposal_pool_check.interpretation: Changing only shared-flow protection/capacity cannot admit these full evidence windows from the unchanged current proposal pool. This is a descriptive limitation of the fixed recorded pool, not proof that any broader selection rule succeeds.

oracle_window_availability.classification: Descriptive gold-informed availability upper bounds only; not an achievable policy result or new experimental arm.

prior_observed_development_context.interpretation: The earlier fixed365-case diagnosis likewise points primarily to complementary-definition allocation. These observed cases and reused query/orders are development evidence, not fresh independent trials.

decision_boundaries.existing_coverage_control: A separately disclosed post-hoc engineering decision may consider the unchanged measured coverage control after operational compatibility tests. This receipt does not relabel it as the failed shared-flow candidate or retroactively claim a prospectively registered promotion.
decision_boundaries.future_research: Retain bounded alternative raw windows per exact definition and study complementary-definition selection under unchanged caps, preserving all individual evidence-group losses in the comparison. Any altered rule requires a separate frozen development protocol and another independent source-reviewed codebase for a future generalization claim.
decision_boundaries.holdout_status: TanStack Query is now observed development evidence. No new policy outcome or generalization claim follows from these descriptive bounds.
